//Serilog: The Worker grades in a loop, so per-statement SQL logging is worse here than in the Api: one
submission is many statements, and none of them is the line an operator wants when a grade fails.
Hangfire stays at Information deliberately — job enqueued/started/succeeded IS this process's
System.Net.Http.HttpClient is a SECRET-HANDLING override and stays at Warning in every environment
file: IHttpClientFactory logs the full request URL at Information, and the Telegram poller's
getUpdates/sendMessage URLs carry the bot token in their path. At Information the token was written
to the log every ~30 seconds, one long-poll at a time.
NOTE: comment keys must live OUTSIDE MinimumLevel.Override — Serilog parses every value in that
map as a log level and throws at startup on anything that is not one.
